ruleDefinitions.name: Use of OpenConsole
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of OpenConsole binary as a LOLBIN to launch other binaries to bypass application Whitelisting

sequences.query: (process_original_file_name = "OpenConsole\.exe" OR process_path = RGX("\\\\OpenConsole\\\.exe$")) AND  NOT (process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\WindowsApps\\\\Microsoft\\\.WindowsTerminal"))
